svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Hub-and-spoke network on Google Cloud
svg.desc: Hub-and-spoke network on Google Cloud. 9 components in 11 groups. Connections: Corporate servers to Edge router; Edge router to Cloud Interconnect (Dedicated Interconnect); Edge router to Cloud VPN (IPsec tunnels); Cloud Router to Cloud Interconnect; Cloud Router to Cloud VPN; Cloud Interconnect to Network Connectivity Center (hybrid spoke); Cloud VPN to Network Connectivity Center (hybrid spoke); Network Connectivity Center to Production VPC (VPC spoke); Network Connectivity Center to Shared services VPC (VPC spoke); Network Connectivity Center to Development VPC (VPC spoke).

text.tspan: On-premises reaches three spoke VPCs through Network Connectivity Center, over Cloud Interconnect with an HA VPN backup
